description: Change one choice — its name, price, whether it is pre-selected, or where it is sold. Everything you leave out stays as it is. unavailableOutletIds is the exception list and REPLACES the stored one: pass [] to make the choice available everywhere again. Marking a choice unsold somewhere can be refused if a category requires more choices than would remain available at every outlet.

price.description: New extra charge, e.g. "0.90". Pass "0" to make it free

unavailableOutletIds.description: REPLACES the exception list. [] = sold at every outlet

name: hub_update_modifier_choice
title: Edit a choice
